title: AI product description button calls a missing route and shows a developer message to users
standards: Nielsen heuristic 9 (help users recover from errors)
expected: With the ai_description_gen flag on (default 100%), the button fills the description, or explains in user terms that AI is unavailable.
actual: The call always 404s. The catch shows the toast 'AI unavailable — add OPENAI_API_KEY to backend/.env' to every user, including in production.
impact: A promoted feature never works, and end users see an internal configuration instruction, which looks unprofessional and hints at server internals.
fix: Call the existing POST /api/ai/generate with the product context (or add the route on the backend), check GET /api/ai/status to hide the button when AI is not configured, and replace the toast with user-facing copy from the locale files.
